استهزأت (form X)
# اِسْتَهْزَأْتُ (istahzaʔtu) /is.tah.zaʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَهْزَأَ (istahzaʔa)
# اِسْتَهْزَأْتَ (istahzaʔta) /is.tah.zaʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَهْزَأَ (istahzaʔa)
# اِسْتَهْزَأْتِ (istahzaʔti) /is.tah.zaʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَهْزَأَ (istahzaʔa)
# اِسْتَهْزَأَتْ (istahzaʔat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
